verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a dedicated OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow explicitly for input-constrained devices/CLIs (auth0-docs-9, auth0-docs-26, auth0-docs-40), and even Auth0's own MCP Server uses this exact flow to let AI tools like Claude Desktop authenticate against a tenant without long-lived secrets (auth0-docs-13, auth0-docs-41, auth0-gh-1), directly matching the ai-native/agent-auth use case. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration outside vendor docs and GitHub description confirming real-world device-flow usage for headless agents.
